This AutoDNA program is created for commercial clients: Fleets of construction companies, taxi services, logistics and courier companies (including Amazon Delivery, FedEx, UPS), municipal and government agencies (City of Calgary Fleet, police, fire departments, school buses), as well as small businesses with a few vehicles.

path.id: It automatically tracks the status of every vehicle (mileage, fuel consumption, ECU errors, temperature, load) and reminds about necessary maintenance, diagnostics, or refueling. The plan integrates with our telematics devices and helps manage the technical condition of tens or hundreds of vehicles without human error.
Vehicles are not idled due to missed maintenance.
The system warns about problems before a breakdown occurs.
Service is planned automatically based on mileage or vehicle condition.
Reduction in fuel consumption and repair costs by up to 20%.
Service without queues, with vehicle delivery to the client.
